text:
Welcome To Kowloon - Official Launch Trailer
Welcome to Kowloon is a first-person psychological horror game set in a dense and oppressive urban environment inspired by Kowloon. You arrive in search of cheap housing, but the place quickly reveals itself to be far more disturbing than it first appears. Explore narrow corridors, cramped apartments, and unsettling locations, uncover the dark secrets hidden behind seemingly ordinary residents, and experience a compact horror story built around atmosphere, tension, and psychological unease.
